rows.comparison_summary:
Sensor: BioTac SP
Group: Commercial (discontinued)
Manufacturer / lab: SynTouch Inc. (California)
Principle: Conductive fluid + impedance electrodes; pressure transducer (hydro-acoustic); thermistor + heater
What it measures: Deformation (normal/shear force, contact point), fluid vibration and pressure, temperature and heat flux; slip, texture, curvature
Resolution (taxels / pixels / spatial): 24 electrodes (vs 19 on the classic BioTac) | Not available
Sampling rate: Electrodes at 100 Hz in Shadow's ROS integration
Price: No official price (company dissolved). Third-party estimates: ≈3,000–5,000+ USD per sensor (not verified); used units on eBay from ≈450 USD
Status: DISCONTINUED: SynTouch dissolved in December 2024; only used/legacy units

rows.name: ReSkin
rows.manufacturer: Meta AI + Carnegie Mellon University (Bhirangi, Hellebrekers, Majidi, Gupta)
rows.status: Open source (MIT); no official sales (commercial derivatives via AnySkin/WowSkin)
rows.principle: Magnetic: elastomer with magnetic microparticles + magnetometers (5× MLX90393)
rows.measured: Contact location and 3-axis force (normal/shear) via learned models; fast signals for slip
rows.dimensions: Skin 2–3 mm thick; reference board ≈20 × 20 mm
rows.surface: Flat/flexible skin adaptable to hands, gloves, sleeves
rows.durability: >50,000 interactions; skin peels off and is replaced 'like a sticker'
rows.bom_cost: <6 USD per skin in a batch of 100 (Meta AI)
rows.key_paper: Bhirangi et al., "ReSkin: versatile, replaceable, lasting tactile skins", CoRL 2021 (PMLR 164)
rows.integrations: Parallel gripper, glove and dog shoe (Meta demos); basis of AnySkin
rows.advantages: Very cheap; thin; replaceable; high sampling rate
rows.drawbacks: Requires learning/calibration; magnetic interference; adhesive between skin and electronics (improved in AnySkin)

Sensor: ReSkin
Group: Research / open hardware
Manufacturer / lab: Meta AI + Carnegie Mellon University (Bhirangi, Hellebrekers, Majidi, Gupta)
Principle: Magnetic: elastomer with magnetic microparticles + magnetometers (5× MLX90393)
What it measures: Contact location and 3-axis force (normal/shear) via learned models; fast signals for slip
Resolution (taxels / pixels / spatial): 5 magnetometers × 3 axes (+ temperature) = 20 values | 1 mm with 90% accuracy (Meta)
Sampling rate: Up to 400 Hz
Price: BOM: <6 USD per skin in a batch of 100 (Meta AI)
Status: Open source (MIT); no official sales (commercial derivatives via AnySkin/WowSkin)
